7.11.3 Interaction with J1939 Diagnostic Manager (J1939)
[SWS_Dem_00971] ⌈In case the TestFailed bit of an event within an primary event
memory changes and a J1939 DTC number is assigned to that event, the function
J1939Dcm_DemTriggerOnDTCStatus shall be called for each DemClient referencing
this DemEventMemorySet⌋(RS_Diag_04112)
